quote: When the signal is circular green alone: Pedestrians facing such a signal may proceed across the highway within any marked or unmarked crosswalk, unless directed otherwise by another device as provided in NRS 484B.283 [NRS-484B-283-1d1, NRS-484B-283-1d2, NRS-484B-283-1d3, NRS-484B-283-1d4].

activation.condition: Pedestrian faces an official circular-green-alone signal at a public highway.

obligation.description: Pedestrian may proceed within a marked or qualifying unmarked crosswalk, subject to another applicable device under NRS 484B.283.

exceptions.source_clause: unless directed otherwise by another device as provided in NRS 484B.283
exceptions.description: unless directed otherwise by another device as provided in NRS 484B.283

timing.description: Original signal, device mode, entry and clearance are joined by frame.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: unless directed otherwise by another device as provided in NRS 484B.283
judgment_calls_needed.note: Device route applicability and source-governed entry or continuation cannot be decided from a synthetic indication label.
